raw_quotes: 5G tower are affecting your health. no matter how far away you live from them

absolute_promises: no matter how far away you live

mechanism: 5G networks are just radio waves and cannot cause diseases because they do not carry viruses. They are physical energy, not biological material. Viruses spread through sneezing or touching contaminated surfaces.
risk_rationale: No direct health risk, but it causes fear and makes people believe 5G waves caused their illness.
overstated_part: Radio waves cannot carry or spread viruses; research on 5G-level radio fields has not found health harm at normal exposure.

evidence.title: 5G mobile networks and health-a state-of-the-science review of the research into low-level RF fields above 6 GHz
evidence.note: Reviews health research on 5G-type radio fields; does not test virus spread directly.

recommended_action: Do not believe claims without a reliable source, and check the scientific research.

claim_text: Drinking bentonite clay is a DIY kidney detox.
raw_quotes: If you want to detox your kidney drink bentonite clay water
mechanism: The kidneys are self-cleansing organs that do not need products promoted as 'detox' or 'kidney cleansers'. These substances can disrupt normal kidney function.
risk_rationale: It may cause intestinal obstruction and harm liver and kidney function because of toxic heavy metal content.
true_part: The kidneys do filter waste from the blood.
overstated_part: They do this on their own; clay does not 'detox' them and may contain heavy metals.

evidence.title: Levels of lead, arsenic, mercury and cadmium in clays for oral use on the Dutch market and estimation of associated risks
evidence.journal: Food Addit Contam Part A Chem Anal Control Expo Risk Assess
evidence.note: Edible clays sold to consumers contained heavy metals at risky levels (safety).

evidence.title: Severe hypokalemia caused by oral and rectal administration of bentonite in a pediatric patient
evidence.note: Bentonite use caused dangerously low potassium in a child (safety).

recommended_action: To keep kidneys healthy, drink water regularly and eat a balanced diet.
